S.FORM: sipunu'ay a pacemutay 天才小釣手 sipunu;ay a pacemutay ci se-ku kaw-siyung nitadasan nida u pacemutay a nu dipun a mangga a nisulitan , inamangga nikatahekalan sa sumad han tu nu Tilibi . . Ina mangga ni se-ku kaw-siyung u tatungus nida kuyni cay kaytini i dipun acacay , i nan-han, Taywan atu Yitali idaw kuni patahekal . . u sapaayaw a musakamu 概要 u situngusay a pawayway makaduduc tu kakawsan ya baki nida ci yi-pin a nipalaylay , , Idaw ku tineng a pacemut kapah ku nalimaan , matineng tu cancanan a buting a kitidaan nikaudip nu buting . . manamuh makaala tu buting misaasu' tu nikaalaan tu heci , ci san-pin hacacacacay han nida misetset , , micunus tu nitanengan , matineng tu yadahay a kakatinengan tu buting . . "musikul tu sakaudip" wiyni ina kacudu nu Tilibi sa u mangga tu sapatucek a kawaw sa . " . musaungayay nu Tilibi 電視動畫 nu Taywan a Tilibi nu hulam ku micuyakuay a musakamu a patahekal , , u ku-sin a tilibi sa nu dipun pasasu alaen a patahekal tu kamu nayi 2013 a mihcaan 3 a bulad 13 a demiad katukuh 2013 a mihcaan 5 ay a bulad 28 a demiad a patahekal a papiadih tu binawlan . . nipatucek a mamutahekal a tademaw atu pangihaay San-pin-san-pin "mihila sangbayi , pangihaay ; yi-ce-ya-ce . ) Kungku nu pawaywayay . 11 kumihcaan katukuh 16 ku mihcaan.故事的主角.11歲～16歲. Sapin-yipin mihila icebayi pangihaay; kung-nay-sin-pin ) baki ni sanpin, ayda a mihca 77, u kasenengan nu katuuday a babalaki . . Cancuwan yisen a yu kawa giyusinsang, pangihaay; yi-ce-na-ce ) i tuluay a nipipacemut i banaw tahekal naming ku pacemutay , pakayni ci sanpinan , mahida u wama nida . . Kawsapayhe Takayama uli , pangihaay pay-se-tung-may 高山百合(高山 ユリ ,配音:白石冬美) i tepalay nis an-pin a limecedan , kibalakiyan ci sapin tu ku mihcaan . uheni aci sanpin mahida u malkakaay , hinapaculi masasusakamu . . Ciya-lay-ce-nce ka-siy-ma-sa-ha-lu , pangihaay:san-pen-kuy-ce ) Ci sapin yu pacemut sa idaw ku mutudu'ay u sayhu , maswnwng ci sanpi cinidaan . . Haylun. Huwa sen "haylun.huwasen" pangihaay: ci-tin-li-paw-ce. 海倫・華生(ヘレン・ワトソン,Helen Watson,配音:吉田理保子) duma tahekalay a tademaw 其他登場人物 san-pinpin "mi-h-ila tay-i-la" 三平平(三平 平 ) u wam ni sapin . u matesekay mibuting a mibutingay , namibuting sa sikawaw kyu mapawan matawal ku nipidateng namahida sa caay tu katinengi ku culil . . Kaw-san-a-cang "Ta-ka-ya-ma ya-se-z-u"高山安藏(高山 安蔵 ) Wama ni pay-hw . atu sakapahay a cabay . . Ay-ce "ay-ku"愛子(愛子 ) Sapi atu yi-sen sayaway i 3 ay abulad makalikeluh tiya tatayna , alaw u saacawaan nida . San-pi-yi "mi-hi-la-ha-zi-may" 三平一(三平 一 ) u kaka ni san-pin . metalaw tu nanum , lu henay kumihcaan maalul i umah mapatay. namahini sa , kyu patucek satu ci yi-pain a pahabay ci san-pinan . u wiyna ni sanpin "san-bay-yi-nu-ha-ha"三平的母親(三平の母 ) malawpes ku sakakaay a wawa tu tatami "yi" , macunus ku kabahal , namulecuh ci sapinan caay henay pakacacay a bulad mapatay tu misangaay a tademaw 製作人員 ma-na-niyaw-man . 等 mikantukay tu mikulit :siyang-cung-yi-i-suing, ku-ko-su-tay, suy-cun-si-se, si-cen-lung-ce, cin-ce-pi-li-se, han-yi-haw . sayaway nami kulit : wiy-ku-kuwang-cun, kaw-ciyaw-min-sin, wiy-ciw-in-cin, san-ku-cung, taw-tin-ing-min, cang-ku-cuwan-sin-se, lin-siw-hu, cin-tin-cen-ce sa. 原畫: 等 misaungayay a kulit : tu-huy-yi-hung ci-ku-kuwang cung-taw-cin-ce, nan-pu-ya-ci-ce, si-cun-huy-li-ce, a-pu-yi-yin, ce-sang-yi-ce, cin-tin-ya-san, pin-yi-i-ce, an-ta-cin-yin sa. 動畫: 等 mikuwanay tu nikulitan: cin-yi-siw-sung 美術監督:千葉秀雄 nu dikuda a sapiadih: siyaw-ci-cuwang-pin,
